A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''duke''' In many cases, this title was passed down through the family bloodline.

[[Duke of Serenno]] was a title held by [[Rodas Borgin]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="SWAEHT">''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets]]''</ref>

[[His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate/Legends|His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate]] manufactured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[E3-standard starship lifeboat/Legends|escape pod]], and was presumably founded by [[His Grace the Duke Gadal-Herm's Safety Inspectorate|Duke Gadal-Herm]].<ref name="ROTSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
